text_block_list.text: The day of the CBC Sho arrives.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sakura Bakushin O, after an intensive concentration session in the waiting room…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: …Departs for the track, carrying the momentum over from her last race!
